title: Rimay János ifjúkori versgyűjteménye (network critical edition, Gépeskönyv)
institution: ELTE BTK Magyar Irodalomtörténeti Intézet, Reneszánszkutatások Posztgraduális Központja (CHER) and BÖIP Tartalomipari Laboratórium; edited by Tóth Tünde
author: Rimay János
notes: Network critical edition (demo 1999, full version 2001-2004) of the early poems of the Hungarian poet János Rimay, edited by Tünde Tóth. The site gives the critical text of the poems (30 poem pages), a repertory of first lines, and the sources: the Fanchali Jób codex (1596-1608), the Balassa codex (after 1656) and further 16th-17th-century manuscripts and prints, which can be compared with the edition. Counts are ours and cover the 30 critical-text pages only: about 7,500 words (letter-only tokens, line numbers and commentary pages left out); the source transcriptions for each witness are in separate pages that were not counted. The pages show a last-modified date of 2006 and no later activity, so the resource is listed as archived. The text opens in nested frames.
